_comment: Guided tour for the Batch Analysis wizard. 'target.name' is a control the emtk app draws (a step in the list, a table, a field's attr, a button's action); 'page' is the step the app opens when the tour reaches the card. A step with 'await' waits for the user to operate its target.

steps.title: One fit, many datasets
steps.text: Every item in the batch starts from the same template parameters, so the numbers that come out are comparable. That only works if the template is good: optimise one representative fit by hand before this. Five steps, listed on the left.

steps.title: Pick datasets already loaded
steps.text: Anything loaded in ChiSurf can join the batch. Open Loaded data in the step list.

await.hint: Click Loaded data in the step list.

steps.title: Tick the ones to fit
steps.text: Each ticked dataset is fitted with the template. Hover a row to see its file. Optional: a batch of files alone is fine.

steps.title: Or add files
steps.text: Files are loaded one by one and fitted after the loaded datasets. Files, Folder (everything below it) and Database add them; you can also drop files on the window.

steps.title: Choose the template
steps.text: The fit whose parameter values and fixed flags seed every run.

steps.title: Where the results go
steps.text: A CSV here; a DOCX report and a ZIP of per-run curve exports are written beside it.

steps.title: Run it
steps.text: Each item is restored to the template, fitted and exported. When it finishes, scan the Chi2r column in Results first: a jump marks a sample the template does not describe.

steps.title: Read the results
steps.text: One row per item and parameter, as in the CSV. Sort by a column, or type in the filter box to narrow the rows.
